tool.description: segment, transcribe, and train models on selected images, PDFs, and annotations

param.name: annotations

tool.help:
Select PNG/JPEG/TIFF images or PDFs (as datasets or an ordered list collection), optionally PAGE/ALTO annotation files or annotation archives, and optionally Kraken ``.mlmodel``/``.safetensors`` segmentation and recognition models. The tool creates one project and document, imports the selection in supplied order, matches annotation files to pages by base filename, loads imported models for immediate use, and opens the regular-user session through Galaxy.
Annotations and models are optional; omit them for a minimal images/PDFs-only workflow.
Work during the session uses the application's normal editing, segmentation, recognition, and training interface; manual exports keep their usual selection. On normal Galaxy Stop the tool additionally exports the latest saved PAGE XML, ALTO XML, and plain text for every document/transcription version, plus any models trained or updated during the session, into the declared history outputs. Export failures are recorded in the job log rather than aborting the stop.
See ``galaxy/README.md`` in the source repository for integration notes and known limitations.
